description: Lists the tokens a Wafermap wallet can swap through the KyberSwap aggregator on one network, with symbol, name and contract address. On Robinhood Chain this includes ETH, WETH, USDG and every Robinhood stock token (TSLA, NVDA, AAPL…); on Base it includes ETH, WETH and USDC. Use it to resolve a ticker to its contract address before quoting or executing a swap with the Wafermap CLI. Read-only and free; it does not trade.

network.description: Which chain's tokens to list. Defaults to robinhood.

name: wafermap_tokens
title: List swappable tokens
